messages.body:
claim: P3.DEPLOY — this agent is executing.

Deploys currently hard-reset the worker VM (#31), which reboots the box: ~1–2 min of 502s per deploy even though the build itself is staged. Zero-downtime design:
- **On-VM convergence**: a systemd timer (60s) compares `git ls-remote` main against the installed sha and runs the staged rebuild + swap in place — no reboot; cutover is a seconds-long service restart
- **Graceful cutover**: Caddy `lb_try_duration` buffers requests across the restart window (no visible errors; SSE clients auto-reconnect); worker handles SIGTERM as a clean stop
- **Smaller attack surface**: `deploy.yml` and the runner SA's `particleWorkerReset` role + compute scope are removed — deploys become pure gitops, and CI jobs are back to zero GCP capabilities

Rollout needs one final reset (to install the timer); after that, never again.

title: P3.DEPLOY — zero-downtime deploys: on-VM convergence, graceful cutover
